items.why: Tech shares bounced back after the sell-off, with Amazon among the Dow's biggest intraday drivers Friday. Analysts also see the stock as attractively valued ahead of Q3 earnings, with AWS growth the swing factor.
Record Cybercab registrations in Texas (150 more, total 319, the largest single-day jump) plus September China wholesale sales of 95,366, the year's best. Tigress reiterated Buy with a $550 target.

Microsoft launched the Surface Laptop Ultra powered by an Nvidia AI chip plus new AI dev tools this week, riding the same tech rebound. Recent analyst upgrades and a Bernstein defense of its AI spending added fuel.
Moving with the broader AI-led tech rebound that pushed the S&P 500 toward record highs. Wall Street remains bullish, with consensus price targets implying further upside ahead of Q3 earnings.

market_note: Indexes headed for weekly gains with the Nasdaq leading as megacap growth caught a bid.
summary: Stocks rebounded Friday with the S&P 500 nearing a fresh record, led by big tech on optimism around an AI-driven Q3 earnings season. Oil slipped after Trump said the US would not strike Iran before the midterms, while telecoms sank on SpaceX's spectrum deal.
